description: This file contains unit tests for the DataElement and related classes in the WPEFramework Core namespace, using Google Test framework. It tests data copying, CRC calculation, buffer management, linked data elements, and data parsing functionalities.

classes.name: DataElement
classes.description: Represents a data element with buffer management, CRC, search, and set/get functionalities.

classes.name: DataStore
classes.description: Manages a buffer with copy, size, and buffer access methods.

classes.name: LinkedDataElement
classes.description: Represents a linked data element that can be enclosed and linked with other data elements.

classes.name: DataElementParser
classes.description: Parses a DataElement, providing size, validity, and byte skipping functionalities.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Copies data into the DataStore or DataElement.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Gets or sets the size of the DataStore or DataElement buffer.

methods.name: CRC32
methods.description: Calculates CRC32 checksum over a range.

methods.name: SearchNumber
methods.description: Searches for a number in the DataElement buffer with specified endianness.

methods.name: SetNumber
methods.description: Sets a number in the DataElement buffer with specified endianness.

methods.name: Search
methods.description: Searches for a sequence within the DataElement.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets a value at a specific offset.

methods.name: Align
methods.description: Aligns the DataElement buffer to a specific boundary.

methods.name: LinkedSize
methods.description: Returns the size of linked data.

methods.name: LinkedElements
methods.description: Returns the number of linked elements.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the DataElement is valid.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Copies data from another DataElement or offset.

methods.name: SkipBytes
methods.description: Skips a number of bytes in the parser.
